Raspberry Pi’s RP2350 Hacking Challenge 2 has been cracked. Well done to Nikhil Tattikota and Vincent Immler!

Using Scatter, a side-channel technique our team published in 2017, they recovered every byte of the AES key from the hardened implementation.

📰 Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25479
